title: Three qubits
desc: Some diseases need two genes broken at once. To search the pairs on a quantum computer, a gene network is cut down to eight cells on three qubits, and its moves into a few building blocks.
page: Three qubits: how a gene network fits on a tiny quantum computer
sub: a gene network on a tiny quantum computer
aria: Interactive 3D story of how a gene network is shrunk onto three qubits and broken into building blocks a quantum computer runs
